title: Extraction of Low-Molecular-Weight Compounds from Mouse Serum and Brain Tissue
author: Carl Olson

steps.title: Prepare extraction solvents
steps.instruction: Mix LC‑MS grade acetonitrile and methanol 1:1 (v/v) and add LC‑MS grade formic acid to 0.1% (v/v) to make the base extraction solvent. (Optional) Prepare a second batch of the same solvent and supplement with internal standard (IS) to a final concentration of ≥200 nM. Aliquot both solvents into labelled tubes, pre‑chill at –20 °C and store overnight until use.

steps.title: Euthanize mouse and collect blood
steps.instruction: Administer a terminal intramuscular overdose of ketamine (120 mg/kg) and xylazine (20 mg/kg). Confirm loss of consciousness and absence of pedal withdrawal reflex. Aspirate 0.5–1.0 mL whole blood from the left ventricle using a 20 GA needle and syringe.

steps.title: Allow clotting and isolate serum
steps.instruction: Transfer blood immediately to labelled uncoated tubes and let it coagulate at room temperature (~25 °C) for 10–15 min. Centrifuge at 2,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C. Carefully transfer the upper serum layer to a fresh labelled tube without disturbing the cell pellet; proceed immediately to extraction or keep on ice.

steps.title: Perfuse mouse and dissect brain
steps.instruction: Transcardially perfuse the animal with 20 mL ice‑cold PBS containing heparin at 20 IU/mL. Remove the brain, weigh it on an analytical balance (expected wet weight ≈230 mg) and record the weight.

steps.title: Add solvent to brain and homogenize
steps.instruction: Place the brain in a pre‑chilled microcentrifuge tube and add pre‑chilled extraction solvent at 3 µL per 1 mg wet tissue (e.g., 230 mg → 690 µL). Homogenize on ice using a Sonoplus UW 2070 probe sonicator (or equivalent) with short bursts to keep the sample cold.

steps.title: Add solvent to serum aliquots
steps.instruction: Aliquot 300 µL of serum into pre‑chilled microcentrifuge tubes. Add three volumes (900 µL) of the pre‑chilled IS extraction solvent if using IS; otherwise add the standard extraction solvent. Vortex briefly.

steps.title: Precipitate proteins by cold incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate all serum and brain samples at –20 °C for 20 min to ensure complete protein precipitation.

steps.title: Centrifuge to clarify extracts
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C. Carefully transfer the clarified supernatant to a fresh tube without disturbing the protein pellet.

steps.title: Filter through 0.22 µm membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a 0.22 µm microcentrifuge filter tube (catalog #CLS8160, Sigma‑Aldrich). Centrifuge at 16,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C and collect the filtrate in a fresh tube.

steps.title: Ultrafiltration with 30 kDa filter
steps.instruction: Transfer the filtrate to a 30 kDa MWCO microcentrifuge filter tube (catalog #MRCF0R030, MilliporeSigma). Centrifuge at 16,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C and collect the flow‑through.

steps.title: Store final extracts
steps.instruction: Transfer all filtered extracts to fresh, labelled microcentrifuge tubes and store at –80 °C until LC‑MS/MS analysis.

steps.title: Prepare calibration extracts
steps.instruction: Process two designated calibration animals using plain extraction solvent (no IS) through the serum and brain extraction steps (steps 3–5). Pool the serum extracts from both animals and separately pool the brain extracts. Spike the pooled matrices with target compounds to generate calibration points spanning 1–1000 nM, and add internal standard at a fixed 100 nM to all calibration points.
